subject: Request: incident-time log and audit artifacts for throughput spike - Acme Payments
messages:
From: Kelsey Wong <kelsey.wong@acmepayments.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>; support@redwood.com
Cc: Thomas Reed <t.reed@acmepay.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate: throughput spike & rising 5xx rate impacting checkout (Acme)

Hi team,

Since ~08:40 PDT we started seeing a sudden drop in throughput and a corresponding rise in 500/502 errors on the Redwood route serving our checkout microservice. Latency p95 has climbed from ~120ms to ~1.4s, and error rate has gone from ~0.2% to ~6%. This is directly impacting live transactions — we are already throttling traffic to reduce failures.

We need the following from Redwood immediately:
- A timestamped snapshot of inference logs (request IDs, model variant, node id/hardware, raw token exchange) for 08:30–09:30 PDT.
- Any routing/fallback events and model-variant fallbacks during that window.
- Confirmation that logs will be preserved (retention hold) and an audit trail with checksums for chain-of-custody.

We may need this for our internal incident review and for downstream regulators. Please escalate to security/compliance and provide an estimated ETA for artifacts.

Kelsey
Kelsey Wong
Head of Platform Reliability
Acme Payments

[Attachment: sample_failed_request_ids.txt (text)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kelsey Wong <kelsey.wong@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: throughput spike & rising 5xx rate impacting checkout (Acme)

Kelsey — thanks for the heads up and I’m sorry for the disruption. I’m escalating to our on-call infra and compliance teams now.

Immediate plan (taking ownership):
1) Rishi and Monica: please preserve all logs and create a read-only snapshot. Record checksums and upload artifacts to a secure bucket; DO NOT purge or aggregate over the originals.
2) Notify security/compliance that this is an incident-time evidence hold — create a chain-of-custody note.
3) I’ll coordinate with Kelsey on delivery mechanism and whether Acme needs signed evidence via secure share or a portal link.

Kelsey — can you confirm the exact object keys or request IDs you'd like prioritized? If you prefer, we can push the full tarball and a CSV summary first and send the larger archive after we verify PII redaction rules.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

On Sun, 21 Mar 2027 at 09:15 AM PDT Kelsey Wong <kelsey.wong@acmepayments.com> wrote:
> Hi team,
>
> Since ~08:40 PDT we started seeing a sudden drop in throughput...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: throughput spike & rising 5xx rate impacting checkout (Acme)

Taking point on artifacts. Work completed so far:
- Pulled raw inference logs for 2027-03-21T08:30:00-2027-03-21T09:30:00 PDT from live shard fleet (nodes nvme-03–nvme-09).
- Created compressed archive redwood_raw_logs_20270321.tar.gz (SHA256: 3b2f...f8a). Uploaded to secure-bucket://evidence/Acme/DL-4982/redwood_raw_logs_20270321.tar.gz (access: read-only, token-limited).
- Exported a summarized metrics CSV (slo-metrics-csv-20270321.csv) with per-minute p50/p95/p99, request counts, 5xx counts, and model-variant routing.
- Generated chain_of_custody_note.pdf documenting pull times, operator identities, and checksums.

Questions for compliance/ops:
- Retention hold: propose 90 days as a default for incident evidence (pending legal).
- PII: logs contain hashed user IDs and truncated request payloads. Do we need additional redaction before delivery?

Next steps: I’ll send a signed link to the secure object and attach the CSV and chain-of-custody note. Marcus — please capture a short replay of the autoscaler and fallback events (timestamps + node ids) and add to the evidence bucket.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_raw_logs_20270321.tar.gz, slo-metrics-csv-20270321.csv, chain_of_custody_note.pdf

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Inference Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Kelsey Wong <kelsey.wong@acmepayments.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Reed <t.reed@acmepay.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: throughput spike & rising 5xx rate impacting checkout (Acme)

Thanks — that’s very helpful and fast. A few follow-ups:
- We need a timestamped audit trail showing when artifacts were exported and who accessed them (to present to our SOC team). Can you include syslog entries or an access log snippet?
- Please confirm the retention hold (90 days is fine for now) and whether Redwood will prevent automated log rotation for this bucket.
- For the CSV: can you include per-region breakdown (us-west/us-east) if available? We want to correlate with our edge region traffic.
- We will request formal SLA credit via our procurement team; please point us to the DocuSign or HubSpot record for the incident so we can link evidence.

Also, is there a secure way for us to verify checksums independently (a signed checksum file or a fingerprint)? If possible, provide a PGP-signed fingerprint or similar.

Kelsey

On Sun, 21 Mar 2027 at 09:28 AM PDT Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kelsey — thanks for the heads up and I’m sorry for the disruption...

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kelsey Wong <kelsey.wong@acmepayments.com>, Thomas Reed <t.reed@acmepay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 23:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: evidence package + next steps (Acme Payments incident)

Kelsey / Thomas — building on Rishi's work, we’ve prepared an evidence package and a short executive summary for Acme. Items delivered to secure-bucket://evidence/Acme/DL-4982/ (read-only, token-limited):

1) redwood_raw_logs_20270321.tar.gz — raw inference logs (SHA256: 3b2f...f8a)
2) slo-metrics-csv-20270321.csv — per-minute SLO metrics; includes per-region columns (us-west, us-east)
3) chain_of_custody_note.pdf — operator audit, pull timestamps, checksum list
4) access_log_snippet.txt — timestamped access events for the artifact upload and the operators who performed the export

Per your request:
- Retention hold is set for 90 days; automated rotation is disabled for the evidence bucket for the duration.
- Checksums are provided in chain_of_custody_note.pdf and we’ve published a PGP-signed checksum file at secure-bucket://evidence/Acme/DL-4982/checksums.asc. Let us know if you need the public key fingerprint.
- HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.example/deal/4982 (we attached the evidence links there).

Next steps I propose:
- We’ll deliver a compiled audit binder by 12:00 PDT tomorrow with a short runbook and exportable CSVs suitable for your SOC review.
- Executive sync: 11:00 PDT tomorrow to walk through items and potential SLA remediation (I’ll schedule a 30-minute slot).

If you want artifacts delivered via an alternative mechanism (DocuSign or a signed transfer), let me know and we’ll coordinate with compliance.

Again — sorry for the impact. We’re committed to getting you everything you need for your review.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_raw_logs_20270321.tar.gz (secure link), slo-metrics-csv-20270321.csv, chain_of_custody_note.pdf, checksums.asc
